intro: Discover Rolf's Fate is an Alliance quest in Elwynn Forest following the trail of two missing Stormwind guards. After finding the mangled remains of Guard Malakai along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake, the trail of webbed prints leads east into a hostile murloc village to uncover what became of his companion, Rolf.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake. In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."
